up: Return all IC50 activity records for the parent compound CHEMBL3182437 and all of its salt forms against the target CHEMBL3430885. For each record, provide the compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, canonical SMILES, activity value with units, assay ChEMBL ID, assay description, document ChEMBL ID, journal name, publication year, and PubMed ID.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
    SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id AS chembl_id, parent.pref_name
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id, child.pref_name
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
    JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437'
)
SELECT
    cs.chembl_id,
    cs.pref_name,
    struct.canonical_smiles,
    act.standard_value || ' ' || act.standard_units AS activity,
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    d.chembl_id AS doc_chembl_id,
    d.journal,
    d.year,
    d.pubmed_id
FROM compound_set cs
JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures struct ON struct.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = act.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3430885'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50';
